The drag force on a car increases with speed. At 20m/s, the total drag force is 400N. The mass
of the car is 1200kg and the driving force is constant at 700N.
Which statement about the acceleration of the car at 20m/s is correct?
The acceleration is 0.25m/s2 but will decrease as time passes.
A
The acceleration is 0.25m/s2 but will increase as time passes.
B
The acceleration is 0.58m/s2 but will decrease as time passes.
C
The acceleration is 0.58m/s2 but will increase as time passes.
D

options.label: A
options.text: The acceleration is 0.25m/s2 but will decrease as time passes.

options.label: B
options.text: The acceleration is 0.25m/s2 but will increase as time passes.

options.label: C
options.text: The acceleration is 0.58m/s2 but will decrease as time passes.

options.label: D
options.text: The acceleration is 0.58m/s2 but will increase as time passes.
